Taking an inexpensive thermometer, gutting it and re-casing it in sapele mahogany. A little woodworking, a little art, turning something that looks cheap into a totally customized piece that now fits into our living room like it belongs. Along the way you'll see the creative process and the design decisions made on the fly.
